source: Blue-tee card (par 71, 5801 yds, 68.2/118). Par and Blue yardage agree hole-for-hole between greenskeeper.org/northern_california/oakland_east_bay_area/Willow_Park_Golf_Course/scorecard.cfm (the course's former name, Willow Park GC) and mscorecard.com/mscorecard/showcourse.php?cid=1563379632945341, with one exception: hole 10 Blue reads 356 on greenskeeper and 386 on mscorecard — 386 is correct because only it reconciles with the back-nine Blue total of 2910 that both sources print (356 gives 2880). Men's handicaps are from greenskeeper (mscorecard prints no SI); verified a complete 1-18 set, running odd 1-17 on the front nine and even 2-18 on the back. Yardages check to 2891/2910/5801 and par to 35/36/71. Cross-checked against imported OSM geometry: the five shortest measured tee_center-to-green_center holes (3, 13, 5, 7, 16) are exactly the five card par 3s, confirming the hole numbering. Nearly every hole measures shorter than the card, as expected for straight-line vs. line of play; largest gaps are the doglegs on 9 (-83) and 15 (-64). The only holes measuring longer than the card are 6 (+25), 17 (+12) and 14 (+2), which are three of the four holes where OSM maps two tee boxes — the importer takes the back-most, which sits behind the Blue marker.
